title: 鐵山礦酸性排水整治
subcategoryTitle: 礦山復育與長期水管理
subcategoryTitleEn: Mine rehabilitation and long-term water management
summary: 以酸性礦水及金屬負荷治理為例，區分稀釋、移除、污泥處置和暴雨影響。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: An acidic mine-water and metal-load case distinguishes dilution, removal, sludge handling and storm effects. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 酸性排水的濃度與日負荷；處理後金屬在水與固體間的去向；暴雨對收集與處理水量的影響
v31FocusEn: Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage; Metal destinations between water and solids after treatment; Storm effects on collection and treatment volumes

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：鐵山礦酸性排水整治
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Iron Mountain Mine remediation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」與「處理後金屬在水與固體間的去向」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage" and "Metal destinations between water and solids after treatment": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage" is correct?
options: 污染影響需同時考慮濃度與流量；毫克每公升等於克每立方公尺，因此日質量負荷要做時間與公斤換算。
出流水濃度下降就證明移除的污染物變多。
污染物在水中測不到就代表已被完全消滅。
optionsEn: Impact requires both concentration and flow.
Lower discharge concentration proves more contaminant removal.
A contaminant no longer detected in water has been completely destroyed.
quiz.explanation: 污染影響需同時考慮濃度與流量；毫克每公升等於克每立方公尺，因此日質量負荷要做時間與公斤換算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Impact requires both concentration and flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 酸性排水的濃度與日負荷：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」如何決定「鐵山礦酸性排水整治」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Iron Mountain Mine remediation”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「鐵山礦酸性排水整治」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」。污染影響需同時考慮濃度與流量；毫克每公升等於克每立方公尺，因此日質量負荷要做時間與公斤換算。濃度下降可能只是稀釋，不能宣稱污染物已移除；本式不推論毒性或法定合格。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Iron Mountain Mine remediation as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses concentration and daily load of acidic drainage. Impact requires both concentration and flow. Milligrams per litre equal grams per cubic metre, so daily mass load needs time and kilogram conversions. Falling concentration may only be dilution, not removal; this formula does not infer toxicity or legal compliance. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」的模型 L = Q·C·24/1000，水質質量負荷的合成教學算例；輸入單位：Q: m³/h; C: mg/L。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model L = Q·C·24/1000 for "Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for water-quality mass load; input units: Q: m³/h; C: mg/L. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
options: 900 kg/d

quiz.explanation: L = Q·C·24/1000；代入 Q = 150 m³/h、C = 25 mg/L，得 90.0 kg/d（水質質量負荷的合成教學算例；輸入單位：Q: m³/h; C: mg/L。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: L = Q·C·24/1000; with Q = 150 m³/h, C = 25 mg/L the result is 90.0 kg/d (synthetic teaching example for water-quality mass load; input units: Q: m³/h; C: mg/L. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 酸性排水的濃度與日負荷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：L = Q·C·24/1000；代入 Q = 150 m³/h、C = 25 mg/L，得 90.0 kg/d（水質質量負荷的合成教學算例；輸入單位：Q: m³/h; C: mg/L。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 C 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: L = Q·C·24/1000; with Q = 150 m³/h, C = 25 mg/L the result is 90.0 kg/d (synthetic teaching example for water-quality mass load; input units: Q: m³/h; C: mg/L. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise C by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：C 增加 10% 時，結果變為 99.0 kg/d（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising C by 10% changes the result to 99.0 kg/d (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 90.0 kg/d（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 C 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 90.0 kg/d (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in C with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」，把合成流量與化驗數據依時間對齊，分別計算瞬時與流量加權日負荷；以平行樣與空白樣判斷品質。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For concentration and daily load of acidic drainage, align synthetic flow and assays in time, calculate instantaneous and flow-weighted daily loads, and assess quality using duplicates and blanks.
quiz.explanation: 針對「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」，把合成流量與化驗數據依時間對齊，分別計算瞬時與流量加權日負荷；以平行樣與空白樣判斷品質。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For concentration and daily load of acidic drainage, align synthetic flow and assays in time, calculate instantaneous and flow-weighted daily loads, and assess quality using duplicates and blanks. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 酸性排水的濃度與日負荷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concentration and daily load of acidic drainage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」，把合成流量與化驗數據依時間對齊，分別計算瞬時與流量加權日負荷；以平行樣與空白樣判斷品質。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For concentration and daily load of acidic drainage, align synthetic flow and assays in time, calculate instantaneous and flow-weighted daily loads, and assess quality using duplicates and blanks. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：同時呈現濃度、流量及負荷，對低於偵測極限的結果用明確方法處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show concentration, flow and load together and explicitly handle below-detection results.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「酸性排水的濃度與日負荷」情境，暴雨時濃度下降但總負荷增加，可能是流量大幅上升；只看濃度圖會把污染增加誤判成改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of concentration and daily load of acidic drainage, storm concentration can fall while total load rises because flow increases sharply; concentration-only plots can mistake greater pollution for improvement. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

A contaminant no longer detected in water has been completely destroyed.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
